name: Chrom
source:
A young man who rescued the protagonist from an attack by a beast when she visited the Green Country. He is taciturn and uncommunicative. He does not want to get along with others. He has a good sense of sight and smell. 

"You can just call me Chrom. I don't like being addressed by honorific titles."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
